summary: Quiet dead-end kerb beside a grassy verge; homes 19-20 m across the road.
reasons: Wide grass verge on own side

drivers.seclusion: Own side is a grassy block with the nearest house 40+ m south; houses 19-20 m opposite.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street; grass verge beside the kerb gives room to pull off the lane.
drivers.traffic: Short quiet side street ending in bush; little through traffic.
drivers.convention: Cars park on the street here; no signs.

flags: Steep: about 5% grade, up to 10% in places
Homes within 25 m across the road
Overhead power lines along the south side
sun_shade: Open to the sun; some trees at the east end.

best_section.where: Todd Street south kerb, beside the open grassy block
